camera.note: The lens dome sits 0.4 mm inside the facet, in a bezel that only clears its rim, so nothing stands in front of the glass. analysis.py models the lens as equidistant with 120 degrees across; the maker states 120 H / 66.7 V / 152.2 D. Real distortion and sharpness at the corners are unknown until a page is photographed.

stability_no_book_tripod.note: Model feet: rear pad 14 mm deep centred 107 mm behind the top edge, blade tips at (+-40, 64).

in_hand.note: Full-hard 300-series stainless shim: yield about 965 MPa (RS PRO datasheet). Check the stock actually bought.

springs.note: Rate taken from the maker's limit point (torque / angle). The spring legs and their seats in the hub and on the leg are not drawn yet: trim and bend on the first build.
